tonight.title: The Quiet Export
tonight.why: A tense, slow-burn heist across three port cities — the kind of film that rewards a dark room and your full attention.

releases.title: Monsoon Wedding Redux
releases.take: A warm, overstuffed family comedy that mostly earns its 2h20.

releases.title: Hollow Point
releases.take: Gorgeous to look at, hollow at the center. Rent, don't rush.

releases.title: The Archivist
releases.take: A quiet sci-fi gem; the year's best ending so far.

critic.title: The Archivist
critic.blurb: If you watch one thing this week, make it this — a patient, humane sci-fi that trusts you to keep up. Streaming on Max; worth the late night.
